payload.body: Shipped opt-in orphaned-blob GC. Safety: (a) off by default — blob.gc handler + recurring sweep only register when blobGc.enabled; (b) grace window (default 7d, configurable) — newer blobs never touched; (c) optional app isReferenced(blobId) hook protects blobs in untyped fields; (d) framework reference set = declared blob-ref fields only (kind:'ref' → schema.blobs) via new blobRefFields() helper. A blob is deleted only if unreferenced by BOTH scan and hook AND past grace. Untyped-field caveat documented in gc-job header, blobRefFields jsdoc, ServerOptions.blobGc, CHANGELOG. Delete order derivatives→bytes→metadata-last. No schema change. Gate: typecheck exit 0; server suite 941 passed / 45 skipped / 0 failures.
